argument: In a multi-machine mobile additive manufacturing system, throughput decreases as the processing time of an additive manufacturing machine increases and as the travel distance of the autonomous mobile robot increases.
boundary: limited to the simulated scenario with specified parameter ranges; transfer to other configurations, real-world conditions, or inclusion of vibration and battery constraints is unestablished
claim: In a multi-machine mobile additive manufacturing system, throughput decreases as the processing time of an additive manufacturing machine increases and as the travel distance of the autonomous mobile robot increases.
conditions: system with 2 AMRs and 2 AM machines
AM machine #1 processing time uniformly distributed between 20 and 40 unit time
AM machine #2 processing time uniformly distributed between 30-70 or 40-80 unit time
AMR moving distance of 15, 30, or 45 unit distance
assembly time uniformly distributed between 10 and 20 unit time
vibration and battery charging constraints are not considered
falsifier: Run a simulation with the same parameter ranges and measure throughput for different processing time and travel distance values to confirm the decreasing trend.

argument: Current video LLMs suboptimally utilize the rich temporal features present in real video data during training.
boundary: Evidence is limited to the two Video LLMs studied and the specific training procedures and benchmark used; transfer to other models, training procedures, or benchmarks is unestablished
claim: Current video LLMs suboptimally utilize the rich temporal features present in real video data during training.
conditions: Models are trained with a multi-stage procedure where the last stage uses real video data
Evaluation is performed on a benchmark that requires temporal reasoning (TVBench)
Comparison is made to baselines trained on image-only or pseudo-video data
falsifier: Train a video LLM on real video data and evaluate its temporal reasoning performance. Compare to a version trained on image-only data or pseudo videos. If the real-video-trained model does not substantially outperform these simpler baselines, it indicates suboptimal utilization of temporal features.
